summary: Drives a Hitbox's active window and cooldown, ticked rather than run as a coroutine.
overview: Swing activates the hitbox for a set duration then deactivates it, with a cooldown between swings. Driven by an explicit Tick rather than a coroutine, specifically so a self-test can advance it in exact increments without entering Play mode — the same reasoning behind the tween handle.
useCases: A melee weapon with real active frames and a rate limit.
An enemy attack that can be tested headlessly.
Matching a swing window to an animation's timing.

params.tuning: The weapon's active frames. Should match the animation's contact window, not its whole length.
Minimum time between swings. Shorter than activeDuration means the next swing can start before the last one ends.

gotchas.title: You have to call Tick
gotchas.body: It is not a coroutine and does not run itself. Nothing happens if nobody advances it.
